definitions.LO_*: stats of the large-cap long-only active return vs the big-cap VW universe
definitions.capm_alpha_ann / beta_vs_universe: OLS of (favoured - RF) on (big universe - RF), monthly, alpha x 12
definitions.capture_LO_vs_LS_all: mean(LO_big active) / mean(published all-cap long-short factor); NaN when factor mean <= 0
definitions.LO_pct_*_pos: share of calendar years / rolling windows with positive compounded active return (relative wealth)

caveats: gross of costs; windows after 2010 are short and noisy
